notes.title: Build 1.0.208
notes.content:
Build 1.0.208
- Added triple jump boots item and mechanics
- Improved chest contents spawn location algorithm
- Updated to latest engine

notes.title: Build 1.0.202
notes.content:
- Added new magic items mechanic. Magic items once acquired can be wielded at the same time as sub weapons. Toggle with Y and use with X. As with all controls, buttons can be swapped in control menu.

- Added new magic potion item to replenish health on demand. Multiple potions can be collected and stored.

- Added new magic amulet item for force field shield. Continued use after a short recharge time.

- Added new magic spell book with bright spell. When cast all enemies on screen will receive double fireball damage. Each spell book can cast 5 spells.  

- Tightened up some hit box and capsule behaviors

- Updated some backgrounds

- Simplified sprite meshes

- Updated to latest engine

notes.title: Build 1.0.196
notes.content:
- Added new visual effects for the 4 sword upgrades to match rings
- Added new visual effects for the 4 dagger upgrades
- Added new treasure room to lake level
- Added animation for upgrade pickups
- Updated player damage animation to use alpha dim for easier tracking

notes.title: Build 1.0.194
notes.content:
- Added additional mechanics to throwing dagger.

- Added additional mechanics for arrows.

- Added hit location animations.

notes.title: Build 1.0.192
notes.content:
- Added new throwing dagger sub weapon. When thrown it boomerangs back to the player. The dagger is a middle range weapon between the long sword and short bow. Sub weapons can now be swapped during game play with controller button. 

- Added additional jump and jump attack patterns to the first and third bosses.

- Added shield wind push back to the third boss.

- Added additional patrol pattern for enemies on platforms.

- Added additional fall behavior for enemies.

- Updated panel and transitions styles.

- Added new mechanic to allow jump cancelling out of a knockback hit while airborne. This gives an additional chance to save being knocked off a platform. Also introduces additional damage boost scenarios.

- Added new double jump mechanic which can be unlocked with magic boots from stage 1 merchant. 

- Updated some level layouts so double jump wouldn’t be too overpowered.

- Upped default continue lives to 10
- Small changes to difficulty

notes.title: Build 1.0.180
notes.content:

   - Reduced number of crows that will appear on Paradox Falls
